mentions.name: iPad Kids Tutor
mentions.description: This iPad app helps kids prepare for exams: they take a photo of a problem they struggle with (initially for math, but it works for any subject), and a backend harness using both Claude and Codex prepares a plan for how to work through the issue.
mentions.problem: Kids preparing for exams tend to ask chatbots like Gemini for ready-made solutions; this app steers them toward working through problems themselves.
mentions.audience: Kids preparing for exams, initially for math but works for any subject
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve built an iPad Kids Tutor app. 
They can take a pic of a problem that they struggle with (initially for math but it works for any subject) and the harness then prepares a plan how to work through the issue using both claude and codex on the backend.
